violations.requirement: The memory range [ptr, ptr + len) must hold properly initialized values of type T. The resulting &mut [T] must refer to initialized data.
violations.explanation: The function is `pub` and safe. It builds a `&mut [u8]` over `buf.as_mut_ptr()` with length `buf.capacity()`, right after `buf.clear()` and `buf.reserve(..)`. Only the spare capacity is covered, and that memory is uninitialized. Creating a `&mut [u8]` over uninitialized bytes breaks the initialization requirement of `from_raw_parts_mut`, so it is undefined behavior. The code should have used `spare_capacity_mut` or `MaybeUninit`.
